full_judgment: 11. Section 26 of the VAT Act contemplates a situation and made provisions for combating the same. Of course the provision should be followed meticulously in its true spirit and purport. If there occurs any deviation in terms of such on 26 of the Act then certainly that can be remedied in a proper forum as it has been done in the instant case by the respondent No. 1 Appellate Tribunal. We find no illegality as such that has been committed in doing so to attract Article 102 of the Constitution. Writ certiorari has its own limitation. While sitting in certiorari this Division would, always be loath to interfere with a case as a Court of appeal. It is well settled which is no longer a res integra. That being the position the irresistible conclusion that follows that this Rule should be discharged being devoid of any substance.
